acceptance: gate:quick-1 Implement the IME wedge fixes from doc/IME-WEDGE-2026-10-09.md (forensic report by Herdr Mobile on the desktop copy of this repo — if the file is absent on your branch, also check other worktrees/remotes; the report lives on the desktop checkout at doc/IME-WEDGE-2026-10-09.md). Symptom: FrankenKey intermittently fails to reshow after a WebView dictation/Send cycle in OMP; pressing Enter or pasting re-arms it. Fix direction per the report: (1) audit onFinishInput ordering vs speech teardown — the mic/dictation path may leave stale state when finishing input; (2) audit isInputViewShown latching — a stale flag can suppress the next show request; (3) implement the watchdog: when an editable field focused (input view expected) but mWindowVisible/isInputViewShown has been hidden beyond a short threshold without a user dismissal, force requestShowSelf. Keep it minimal and inside Keyboard2.java + related IME surface classes. Report the committed sha in closing.
